name: Grade 7 IT Practice: May Week 11 - Testing and Debugging
description: Practice words for debugging and documenting robot performance.

words.definition: To find and fix a problem in code.
words.example: The team debugged the robot after it missed the turn.
The first trial showed the robot stopped too early.

words.definition: A change that makes something better.
words.example: The improvement made the turn shorter.
Performance improved when the robot finished faster and stayed on path.

words.definition: Notes or records that explain the work.
words.example: Documentation recorded the speed, time, and result.

words.definition: Thinking about what happened and what you learned.
words.example: The reflection explained what the team would change next time.
